title: Colour in the dal, immediately
body: Dummy review: the tin looks considered. Bloomed in ghee and the kitchen went quiet. Will restock when lots are live.
author: Ananya S.

title: Fine mill, not dusty
body: Does not clump like the supermarket tin. Soma is storage: we just close it.
author: Rahul M.

title: Red first
body: The gravy looked finished before it tasted hot. That is mastery.
author: Fatima K.

title: Weeknight tin
body: One spoon on mixed vegetables. No extra five masalas. Trust.
author: Pratik (founder dummy note)

title: Roti that needs no speech
body: Sweeter than our usual atta. We make fewer. Better.
author: Meera D.

title: Filter, not a stunt
body: Jaggery and peel. Dummy lot still tasted like a place.
author: Arjun P.

title: Chai backbone
body: Stands up to milk. Morning is quieter when the tea is decided.
author: Daxesh (founder dummy note)

title: Smells like the south, not perfume
author: Lakshmi R.

title: Coarse, as it should be
body: Gingelly oil, idli, no conversation needed.
author: Mayank (founder dummy note)

title: Foreign tin that still feels ours
body: Peppery. On tomatoes with oregano. World chapter works.
author: Nina V.
